EQUIPMENT LEASE AGREEMENT

Th1s Equipment Lease Agreement (the "Lease") is made between Cascade Ma-
chine Works Ltd ("Lessor") and Ridgeline Fabrication GmbH ("Lessee").

l. LEASED EQUIPMENT

1.l  Lessor leases to Lessee one (l) CNC machining centre, serial no.
CMW-88-l207, together with the tooling package listed in Schedule A.

2. TERM AND COMMENCEMENT

2.1  The Lease commences on 0l March 2024 and continues for thirty-six (36)
months unless terminated earlier.

3. RENT

3.1  Lessee shall pay monthly rent of EUR 4.850,00 in advance on the first
busi-
ness day of each month.

3.2  A security deposit of EUR 14.550,00 is payable on commencement.

3.3  Rent is subject to annual indexation in accordance with the German con-
sumer price index.

4. MAINTENANCE

4.1  Lessee shall maintain the equipment in accordance with the manu-
facturer's schedule and shall keep a maintenance log available for inspec-
tion.

5. INSURANCE

5.1  Lessee shall insure the equipment for its full replacement value of
EUR 210.000,00.

6. GOVERNING LAW

6.l  This Lease is governed by the laws of Germany.

Signed at Stuttgart on 0l March 2024.
